DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Four Times Stronger

STS-HS9-L2-13001400-HSSCIPHY-EXL-API-01 • HS Physical Science • Coulomb’s Law and Electrostatic Forces
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
An expedition log is a record of what a team finds, one day at a time. Emi, Haruki, and Nao are keeping one for a study of Sakurajima, a volcano in southern Japan where ash clouds make their own lightning. Inside the cloud, ash grains collide and pick up opposite charges, and every charged grain pulls on every other charged grain. The pull grows much stronger as two grains get closer together.
Two charged ash grains move from 4 centimeters apart to 2 centimeters apart. How many times stronger does the pull between them become?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
